sqlStatements: WITH organization AS (SELECT id FROM pmec.organizations WHERE slug = 'pmec'), person AS (INSERT INTO pmec.people (organization_id, work_email, first_name, last_name, preferred_name, department, job_title, is_employee, active) SELECT organization.id, 'aaroncroes@raiaaruba.com'::citext, 'Aaron', 'Croes', 'Aaron', 'Executive', 'PMEC HR Payroll Administrator', false, true FROM organization ON CONFLICT (organization_id, work_email) DO UPDATE SET first_name = EXCLUDED.first_name, last_name = EXCLUDED.last_name, preferred_name = EXCLUDED.preferred_name, department = EXCLUDED.department, job_title = EXCLUDED.job_title, is_employee = EXCLUDED.is_employee, active = true, updated_at = now() RETURNING id, organization_id), identity_binding AS (INSERT INTO pmec.auth_identities (person_id, provider, external_subject, verified_email, last_authenticated_at) SELECT person.id, 'clerk'::pmec.identity_provider, 'user_3IO6MJn5mivgfqoF62PBisNV2f4', 'aaroncroes@raiaaruba.com'::citext, now() FROM person ON CONFLICT (provider, external_subject) DO UPDATE SET person_id = EXCLUDED.person_id, verified_email = EXCLUDED.verified_email, last_authenticated_at = EXCLUDED.last_authenticated_at RETURNING person_id), membership AS (INSERT INTO pmec.memberships (organization_id, person_id, role, status, allowed_surface, granted_by_person_id, granted_at, activated_at) SELECT person.organization_id, person.id, 'hr_manager'::pmec.role_code, 'active'::pmec.membership_status, 'operations_web'::pmec.client_surface, person.id, now(), now() FROM person JOIN identity_binding ON identity_binding.person_id = person.id ON CONFLICT (organization_id, person_id, role) DO UPDATE SET status = 'active'::pmec.membership_status, allowed_surface = 'operations_web'::pmec.client_surface, activated_at = COALESCE(pmec.memberships.activated_at, now()), updated_at = now() RETURNING id, organization_id, person_id) INSERT INTO pmec.audit_events (organization_id, actor_person_id, event_type, entity_type, entity_id, payload) SELECT membership.organization_id, membership.person_id, 'membership.granted', 'membership', membership.id, jsonb_build_object('role', 'hr_manager', 'permission', 'payroll.review', 'provider', 'clerk', 'source', 'authorized initial setup') FROM membership RETURNING id, entity_id, event_type;
